thread:
ellie-sales: Heads up — we started a POC with BlueHarbor; they want to bring a custom fine-tuned model (cerulean-13b-ft) and test latency/cost on a 4k token context. Can we run a quick compat check?

devin-ml: quick q: is it a HuggingFace-style checkpoint or a Triton-delivered bundle?
ellie-sales: HF checkpoint, includes custom tokenizers and a small adapter. customer will want prefix cache and embeddings for rerank.
devin-ml: ok. adapter + HF mostly fine. two things to flag: 1) custom tokenizer might change tokenization length distribution — will affect batching. 2) adapters mean KV cache layout is standard, but we should run a KV-consistency test.
tao-eng: infra side: requested throughput?
ellie-sales: POC target is 50 req/s tail-latency < 350ms for 512 tokens where possible. If not, they accept 95th < 500ms.
tao-eng: 50rps @ 512 tok is doable on dedicated L4s if we do 8-bit quant and continuous batching. For hosted, might need burst nodes. Also need to confirm memory for 4k context.
devin-ml: memory will be the constraint. cerulean-13b-ft in fp16 w/ 4k ~ ~25-28GB VRAM before kv cache — depends on tokenizer overhead. 8-bit + qkv fusion drops it to ~14-18GB. Recommend we produce a quant variant (int8) for the POC.
ellie-sales: customer asked about compatibility issues with our runtime — will quant break correctness?
devin-ml: small deltas expected. We should run a baseline eval on their prompts. Suggest the quick checklist: 
- generate with fp16
- generate with int8 quant (same seeds)
- compare perplexity/ROUGE on spot tests
- run KV prefix correctness on stateful sessions

maria-legal: from security side: they flagged KMS and data residency. Are they sending PII? They said de-id but need contractual wording. I'll need the model provenance + whether any third-party weights used.
ellie-sales: they used public base + internal fine-tune. they want BYOK.
maria-legal: OK — we need to confirm BYOK flow works on Dedicated/Private and what logs we capture. I'll send sec questionnaire items.
infra-bot: deploy-checklist: [MODEL_BUNDLE_CHECK], [TOKENIZER_SANITY], [KV_CACHE_TEST], [QUANT_VARIANT_EXISTS], [KMS_BYOK_CAPABLE]
tao-eng: for deployment: advise on two variants in catalog: cerulean-13b-ft-fp16 (baseline) and cerulean-13b-ft-int8 (quant). Route POC traffic to int8 for cost but have fp16 canary for quality checks. Use model pinning so we can roll back.
ellie-sales: pricing ask — they want estimates for hosted vs dedicated for 30-day POC at their target throughput.
tao-eng: rough calc: hosted (shared) ~= $0.18/token-hour at 512 tokens avg (ballpark) — not great. Dedicated preemptible pool or reserved L4 nodes: monthly committed node ~ cheaper per-token for sustained load. I'll get a more concrete quote after we size exact batch params.
devin-ml: also consider enabling prefix cache for repeated prompts — that cuts token cost significantly for rerank flows.
ellie-sales: action items: 
- devin: run quick quality delta eval (fp16 vs int8) on their 200 prompt set — can you return a pass/fail + delta numbers by EOD?
- tao: do a capacity sketch and pricing delta hosted vs dedicated for 30-day POC by EOD?
- maria: add BYOK + provenance ask to their security questionnaire and confirm acceptability for Private deployment.

devin-ml: will do. sharing minimal command I'll use: 
```
# export and run eval
python eval_scripts/compare_variants.py --model hf://blueharbor/cerulean-13b-ft --quant int8 --prompts pset_200.json --out ./results/cerulean_poc.json
```
I'll post results to this thread.
tao-eng: i'll run perf sketch against our perf-sim with these params: tokens=512, ctx=4096, batch_target=8, concurrency=6. If we need lower latency, we may drop batch_target.
ellie-sales: thanks — FYI customer also asked about SLA during POC (uptime guarantees). can we offer a sensible dev SLA?
tao-eng: POC SLA is usually best-effort on hosted. For Dedicated we can offer an uptime target if they take reserved nodes and an inc-response SLA. I'll outline options.
maria-legal: adding note — if they insist on audit logs + retention > 90 days, that's an enterprise add-on (compliance retention).
ellie-sales: perfect. I'll sync with BlueHarbor and loop in their infra contact for tokenization samples.
infra-bot: reminder: create temporary catalog entry "cerulean-13b-ft-poc-temp" for test routing — use tag poc/blueharbor.
devin-ml: posted eval summary: int8 vs fp16 delta: mean token probs diff 0.6%, BLEU/ROUGE changes negligible on the 200-set. KV prefix tests passed for 95/100 sessions — failing cases linked (edge of tokenizer mismatch). Recommendation: proceed with int8 for POC, but run a small tokenizer alignment pass.
ellie-sales: awesome. I'll schedule a quick call tomorrow to run tokenizer samples with them. :thumbsup:
